# 74H55 - 2-wide 4-input AND-OR-INVERT gates

Package DIP-14 · family 74H · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74H55.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74H55.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 14 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74H55 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74H55.png) | ![74H55 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74H55.png) | ![74H55 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74H55.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | A | input |  |  |
| 2 | B | input |  |  |
| 3 | C | input |  |  |
| 4 | D | input |  |  |
| 5 | X | analog |  | expander node: connect to the X output of up to four 74H60 or one 74H62 expander; leave open if not used |
| 6 | NC | nc |  |  |
| 7 | GND | ground |  |  |
| 8 | Y | output | totem-pole |  |
| 9 | /X | analog |  | expander node: connect to the X-bar output of the expander; leave open if not used |
| 10 | E | input |  |  |
| 11 | F | input |  |  |
| 12 | G | input |  |  |
| 13 | H | input |  |  |
| 14 | VCC | power |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 8 | Y = NOT ((A AND B AND C AND D) OR (E AND F AND G AND H) OR X) | Y is low when ABCD are all high, or EFGH are all high, or an expander on X/X' is true (X = output of a 74H60 or 74H62). |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 20 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.5 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Designed for use with up to four 74H60 expanders or one 74H62 expander. |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| any | Y | PLH | 7 | 11 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 25 pF, RL 280 ohm, expander pins open |
| any | Y | PHL | 6.5 | 11 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 25 pF, RL 280 ohm, expander pins open |
| any | Y | PLH | 11.4 |  | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 25 pF, RL 280 ohm, C = 15 pF from GND to X' |
| any | Y | PHL | 7.7 |  | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 25 pF, RL 280 ohm, C = 15 pF from GND to X' |

## Not known

- Maximum propagation delay with 15 pF on the expander node: the table gives typical values only.

## Notes

The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.

- [TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, section 5 (pin assignments and function tables)](https://bitsavers.mirrorservice.org/components/ti/_dataBooks/1976_TI_The_TTL_Data_Book_2ed/05.pdf) - 5-19 (PDF page 19); SN74H55 (J, N package)
